D: A fussy small-town detective inherits a slobbering dog who witnessed a murder.
P: Serve the mains when Hooch wrecks the car.
S: Cypress Beach on the California coast
Grated Monterey Jack baked in small piles at 200C for 7 minutes until lacy and golden, cooled into crisps, with salsa.
the seafood plant at the centre of the case

Prawns sizzled in olive oil with sliced garlic, chilli, white wine and butter, finished with parsley and lemon, crusty bread for the pan juices. Peel and devein 800g green king prawns, leaving the tails on. Heat 80ml olive oil in a large pan with 6 sliced garlic cloves and 1 sliced red chilli until the garlic just colours. Add the prawns and cook 2 minutes, turning. Add 80ml white wine and 30g butter and bubble 1 minute until the prawns are pink. Toss with chopped parsley and lemon juice. Serve with a warm sliced baguette.
for Hooch, who eats everything anyway
Parmesan crackers cut into bone shapes: flour, butter, parmesan and an egg, rolled 4mm, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
M: Steak, and the bone for Hooch
T-bone seared and finished at 200C, rested, with garlic butter, roast potatoes and green beans.
Cypress Beach beer-battered fish and chips
a coastal town built around its seafood plant

Flathead in a crisp beer batter, fried golden, with double-fried chips, homemade tartare with capers and gherkins, and lemon wedges. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour and 50g cornflour with 300ml cold lager and a pinch of salt. Dust 8 flathead fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with chopped capers, gherkins, parsley and lemon juice for tartare.
W: Vanilla ice cream with whipped cream, crushed shortbread and a drizzle of salted caramel (sugar cooked amber, cream and salt).
K: Turner's neat-freak breakfast, before Hooch moves in

Fresh blood orange and orange juice topped with cold sparkling wine in chilled flutes, with a twist of orange peel. No slobber allowed. Squeeze 4 blood oranges and 2 regular oranges and strain the juice into a jug. Chill. Pour 60ml of juice into each of 4 chilled flutes, tilting the glass. Top slowly with cold sparkling wine. Garnish each with a thin twist of orange peel. If blood oranges are out of season, use all regular oranges and a splash of pomegranate juice.

s.note: Cypress Beach on the California coast
s.how: Grate 250g Monterey Jack. Make 20 small piles on 2 lined trays, sprinkle with a pinch of chilli flakes and bake at 200C for 7 minutes until lacy and golden. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes until crisp and serve with 200g salsa.

s.note: for Hooch, who eats everything anyway
s.how: Rub 80g cold butter into 150g flour, then mix in 60g grated parmesan and 1 egg into a dough. Roll to 4mm, cut into bone shapes and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Cool on a rack.

m.n: Steak, and the bone for Hooch
m.how: Roast 1kg halved potatoes at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 T-bones hard, finish at 200C for 6 minutes and rest. Top with 60g butter mashed with 2 garlic cloves. Steam 300g green beans. Save a bone for the dog.

w.how: Cook 100g sugar to amber, whisk in 100ml cream and a pinch of salt, and cool. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four cups, top with 200ml whipped cream, crushed shortbread and a drizzle of the caramel.
